notes: IosCompositePermissionService routes camera to AVFoundation, microphone to AVAudioSession, Photos and Videos to PHPhotoLibrary, notifications to UNUserNotificationCenter, and contacts to Contacts.

iOS has no blanket Files authorization. The portable preflight returns Granted, while UIDocumentPickerViewController grants access only to the URL selected by the person and the existing host imports a sandbox copy.
PHPickerViewController keeps its privacy-preserving selection behavior and does not request general photo-library access merely to open the gallery picker.
The Info.plist retains camera, microphone and photo-library usage descriptions. No new entitlement, signing mode or broad storage permission is introduced.
